findings.description: The introductory section defines the scheme as targeting "destitutes, defined as any person who has little or no regular means of subsistence ... to be identified by the States and UTs". This eligibility condition is not captured in the draft extraction, which only includes age, BPL status, and widow‑AIDS criteria. A predicate representing the destitute condition should be added.
findings.source_quote: targeting the destitutes, defined as any person who has little or no regular means of subsistence from his / her own source of income or through financial support from family members or other sources, to be identified by the States and UTs

reasons: source quote verbatim, confidence above threshold, no contradicting signals
